newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Corobrik buys Cullinan factory.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Corobrik buys Cullinan factory.

text.p: South Africa's Corobrik, part of Tongaat-Hullet, said on Monday it had agreed to buy a brick factory from Cullinan Brick, a unit of Cullinan Holdings Ltd, for an undisclosed sum.
The factory, based in Midrand just north of Johannesburg, will boost Corobrik's capacity by 50 million bricks a year.

South Africa's brick industry is going through a period of poor trading as market watchers await an upturn in the building sector. But Corobrik managing director Peter du Trevou said most of the factory's 125 production jobs would be safeguarded by the buy.

"Although there will be some rationalisation of staffing, we will do our best to re-employ as many of Cullinan's production staff as possible either at this plant or by absorbing them into other Corobrik factories," he said.
Du Trevou added that Corobrik will rationalise the acquired plant's product range to stabilise costs and focus on increasing supplies of more popular ranges.
"Corobrik has successfully kept its price increases within the rate of inflation and our aim is to maintain this policy," he said.
Cullinan made the sale as part of a rationalisation programme ahead of its merger with Midmacor.
